scheme_name: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology
other_conditions: Must have a master's degree in engineering, technology or pharmacy with at least 55% marks.
Must hold an M.E. or M.Tech. degree (or equivalent).
Age limit is 40 years as on 1 July of the award year; can be extended by five years for women and SC/ST candidates.
Reservation of 22.5% of fellowships for SC/ST candidates; if not filled, slots go to general candidates.
Candidates from subjects such as geology and geo‑physics are excluded.
benefits_summary: Provides a fellowship of Rs 14,000 per month for the first two years and Rs 15,000 per month thereafter, along with contingency, departmental assistance and other allowances.
documents_required: Joining Report signed by the supervisor/head of department
